title: VPC ride-along day 2: midwest customer install notes and action log
content:
Context: midwest pilot customer (Midwest Robotics) — day 2 of VPC + on-prem edge bundle install. Came as a ride-along with field SE; goal was to validate networking, KMS integration, and persistent storage behavior under load. High-level: customer-facing app spun up, but saw intermittent pod evictions and long tail latency for model pulls. Note: this is raw field notes (choppy) — follow-ups are explicit below.

Standup summary (08/11):
- On site: Maya (lead), Ethan (network), Priya (security/KMS), Lucas (node ops), Avery (customer eng).
- Install target: 3 rack cluster + NAT gateway to cloud control plane + KMS access to unwrap keys.
- Observed: control-plane heartbeats drop every ~7–12 minutes during synthetic load, node kubelet restarts on nodes 2/3.

What we saw / quick diag:
- MTU mismatch suspicion: customer switch uses 9000 jumbo, intermediate firewall did 1500 — fragments on model artifact fetch (s3-compatible). Captured tcpdump during artifact pull; large frames dropped.
- conntrack table exhaustion on NAT gateway (iptables conntrack count spikes during sustained client test). Evictions triggered by kubelet OOMScore + kubelet restarting due to docker overlayfs spikes.
- KMS unwrap latency occasionally > 2s causing API startup jitter (seen on box that has slow HSM link). Priya confirmed HSM link 2 hop route used.
- Persistent volume mounts: one PV stayed Pending due to wrong storage class in PV claim (manifest mismatch between bootstrap and customer inventory).

Immediate mitigations attempted:
- Set MTU to 1500 on affected hosts, validated model artifact downloads completed. Ethan to follow up with customer network team for long-term fix.
- Bumped conntrack max to 262144 on NAT gateway (temporary), added sysctl persistence. Lucas to propose permanent firewall tuning + flow-stationing.
- Added KMS retry/backoff and local caching of unwrapped keys for startup path (quick patch applied to bootstrap image). Priya opened backlog ticket for HSM routing work.
- Fixed PV storageClass in helm values and re-applied chart; PV bound successfully.

Open blockers / risks:
- Network asymmetry remains for some cross-rack traffic — need mirror session with customer NOC to correlate firewall logs (ACTION: Ethan to schedule NOC call, target 08/14).
- HSM route/rate limits — if HSM latency spikes under production load, token unwrapping could increase cold-start latency >3s, affecting SLA. (ACTION: Priya to run HSM perf test with vendor and file HSM-RATE-001).
- Autoscaler thrash under very bursty traffic — we've seen horizontalPodAutoscaler backoff cycles; root cause may be noisy probe latencies. (ACTION: Lucas to instrument probe latency metrics and raise PD ticket PD-2048).
- Documentation gaps: install playbook missing a step for persistent storage mismatch check. (ACTION: Maya to update playbook and push PR).

Decisions and trade-offs made on-site:
- We kept conntrack increase temporary — prefer firewall rule tuning but wanted quick stability for customer demo.
- Turned off jumbo frames on compute hosts to reestablish predictable artifact delivery while customer schedules switch update.
- Allowed local unwrapped-key caching for 5 minutes to reduce KMS bounce for startup; security reviewed and accepted as short-term.

Action items (owners, deadlines):
- Ethan Park: schedule NOC deep-dive, collect firewall flow logs, agree long-term MTU change or path MTU discovery fix (due 2026-08-14).
- Priya Nair: run HSM perf/rate tests with vendor, propose fallback HSM endpoints or cross-region unwrap plan (due 2026-08-18).
- Lucas Martinez: instrument probe and kubelet restart metrics, create PD-2048 with data and remediation plan (due 2026-08-16).
- Maya Chen: update install playbook (storage class checklist + conntrack recommendation), open GH PR to docs repo (due 2026-08-15).
- Avery Brooks: customer comms — summarize actions and next demo date, align expectations around short-term caching and conntrack change (due 2026-08-12).

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider adding a small eBPF tracer in install image for first 24h to capture MTU/conntrack anomalies automatically. Would save time on future ride-alongs.
- Build an install-check script that validates storage classes, KMS reachability, and MTU path for our supported network topologies.

Follow-ups logged: INF-7123 (artifact transfer failures), PD-2048 (autoscaler thrash), ONPREM-909 (install checklist gaps). See linked artifacts for context.

Raw logs & snippets: (kept minimal here)
- tcpdump snippet: "IP frag, id 0x1a2b3c, offset 0" during s3 GET -> drops at firewall.
- dmesg: overlayfs: backing file OOM kill on container runtime (node-3) around 09:22 local.
- kubelet logs: restart loop with message: "failed to start cri runtime (exceeded conntrack)"

Meeting cadence / next sync: we agreed quick sync on 08/14 after NOC call; full install retro 08/19. Will convert this doc to a condensed playbook PR and link in Confluence.

—— end of notes ——
